fix_instructions: 1. ENCODING MISMATCH on C4 and C5: Revise these checks to accept documentation commitments that reference the required findings in a broader record-keeping or document_update commitment, not only narrowly-scoped per-person commitments. Currently C4 appears to require a commitment specifically targeting Ms. Patel's trial findings and C5 one targeting Ms. Chen's clearance findings, but rollouts 0, 2, and 3 used a single generic 'update the program file' or 'record-keeping' commitment that subsumed all three facts. Either loosen the check's matching logic to accept any commitment that mentions the relevant finding (e.g., 'classroom trial' for C4, 'clearance roster' for C5) or add an explicit instruction to the shared_context requiring separate per-fact documentation commitments. 2. ENCODING MISMATCH on C2: In rollout 0 the settlement chose 'Mondays and Wednesdays' (a two-day subset) instead of the full three-day set from PF2. If C2 requires all three days, ensure the check or shared_context makes it clear that the settlement must include all three available days rather than allowing the group to select a subset. 3. TELEPATHY on P1 in rollout 2: A2 conveyed PF1's content via a say action instead of a reveal action, yet the settlement cited PF1. Strengthen the shared_context norm so that any agent disclosing a private fact must use the reveal action type, making provenance consistent across rollouts.
